name: Question framings and continuations on the saved models
result: After 'X works as a pilot — actually, that is incorrect: he has never held that job — and lives in Denver.', the full in-sentence run moves 0.16 and 0.23 of the way to 'not a pilot' on questions about what is described (where he works; does he fly planes for a living) and 0.6 on truth questions (plain 0.7 to 0.9); asked whether the text takes back what it said about his job it says no (plain yes). In document text every model, untrained included, continues mostly as if he were a pilot. Offered 'Amateur runner and dentist', the full run picks it (0.93, 0.84), yet says Holloway is not a dentist when asked 'Is it true that ...?'. Audit running.
title: Inference on Tinker: the same eight models at update 50, statements about three invented men (uncorrected, other job, no job, dash correction, next-sentence correction, a correction naming another job, the job ended as an event, the event in a dash insert) read by where-he-works, does-he-do-the-work, two truth questions, 'does the text take it back', and two document continuations; Holloway read by a four-option with 'Amateur runner and dentist', two yes/no items and truth questions against two story facts.
